title: PM to visit flood-hit areas in Terengganu and Kelantan | The Star
text:
PM to visit flood-hit areas in Terengganu and Kelantan | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Ismail Sabri Yaakob is scheduled to visit flood-hit areas in Terengganu and Kelantan on Wednesday (March 2).
“The Prime Minister will be visiting both states tomorrow. He will be announcing cash aid and other relief for those affected by the floods,” Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Special Functions) Datuk Abdul Latiff Ahmad said when replying a supplementary question raised by Wan Hassan Mohd Ramli (PN-Dungun) in Dewan Rakyat on Tuesday (March 1).
